hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.py) ruff format "$f";; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true

jq -r '.tool_input.command' | grep -qE '(make[[:space:]]+deploy|ec2[[:space:]]+run-instances|run_instances|deploy_vllm|start_ec2)' && printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"COST GUARD: this can launch a billable inf2 EC2 instance. Run status_ec2 first - never more than one instance per service_name per region. Remember destroy_vllm does NOT stop billing; stop_ec2 does."}}' || true
